authority_rule: The original SHA256SUMS is preserved as release provenance. The derived Git-tree manifest is a separate machine-readable projection over the exact tagged Git blobs; it does not rewrite or supersede DOI-bound archive bytes.
claim_boundary: A checksum match proves byte identity in the declared hash domain only. It is not conformance, implementation, safety, legal, certification, or deployment evidence.

legacy_manifest.machine_interpretation: Do not use this file as a portable Git-tree manifest: it includes .git internals, records CRLF release-worktree representations for many text files, and contains three public-path digests that do not equal the tagged Git blobs in either raw-LF or CRLF projection.

derived_git_tree_manifest.path_set_rule: Exactly git ls-tree -r --name-only of source_commit, including the preserved legacy SHA256SUMS file and excluding all .git internals by construction.

verification.prerequisite: The exact source_commit must exist in the local Git object database; fetch tag cgam-v0.1.1 when using a shallow clone.
